decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The loss of the existing business use (B1 Use Class) would reduce business provision and increase redevelopment pressure on maunfacturing workshops which would be harmful to the character and function of the area as a centre for the jewellery trade, and would be contrary to the requirements of policy E2 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006, and to the guidance given in chapter 9 of the Food, Drink and Entertainment and Specialist and Retail Uses Supplementary Planning Guidance for Central London 2004.
Reason : 2 - The proposal does not include any car parking provision and would be likely to incease demand for on-street parking in an area where existing on-street parking spaces cannot meet demand, contrary to the requirements of policies T9A and T8 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary  Development Plan 2006 and the associated Camden Planning Guidance 2006.
 
Reason : 3 - The proposed residential accommodation would be likely to increase the pressure on local educational facilites that are already operating at full capacity, contrary to the requriements of policy SD2 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006, and the associated Camden Planning Guidance 2006.
description: Change of use from office (Class B1) to residential (Class C3) use on 1st to 6th floors to create 10 new self-contained units (one x 1 bed, seven x 2 bed and two x 3 bed units), removal of existing external fire escape at rear and replacement with an extension between 2nd and 6th floors, replacement of windows with new steel double glazed windows, and associated internal and external alterations.
